headline: Air quality alert: Dhaka ranks world's third most polluted city on Sunday
summary: The capital city faced severe air pollution levels on Sunday morning, climbing to the third spot globally.
details: Dhaka has been ranked as the third most polluted city in the world on Sunday morning.
The city's air quality index has reached critical levels, posing significant health risks to residents.
Air pollution in the Dhaka metropolitan area is a recurring issue, often peaking during the winter months.
Residents are advised to take precautions to protect themselves from the hazardous air quality.

headline: 250 dead as dengue cases surge 74% compared to last year
summary: Health officials report a sharp rise in infections and deaths, with hospitals struggling to manage the overflow of patients.
details: According to the Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS), 250 people have died from dengue up to October 2 this year. This marks the fourth-highest annual death toll since the outbreak began in 2000.
caption:
250 deaths and a 74% surge in cases. Bangladesh is facing a critical dengue crisis.

According to the Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS), 250 people have died from dengue up to October 2 this year. This marks the fourth-highest annual death toll since the outbreak began in 2000.
